content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHFWS Chitradurga Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit the application in biodata form with attested documents of the prescribed qualification. Submit it at the Office of the District Mental Health Programme Implementation Officer, Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, Chitradurga. Enclose the required documents in original and 2 attested copies. Submit between 21-11-2026 and 4:30 PM on 05-12-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHFWS Chitradurga Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHFWS Chitradurga Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 Psychiatrist, 2 Clinical Psychologist / Psychologist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHFWS Chitradurga Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form hours 10.00 AM to 4.30 PM at the office; post details on https://nhm.karnataka.gov.in) and send it to Office of the District Mental Health Programme Implementation Officer, Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, Chitradurga, by by hand, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.1,10000 for Psychiatrist, Rs.25000 for Clinical Psychologist / Psychologist.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Psychiatrist: MBBS and MD in Psychiatry or DNB Psychiatry or DPM from an MCI-recognised institution. Clinical Psychologist / Psychologist: PG Degree in Psychology/Applied Psychology and M.Phil in Medical & Social Psychology or Mental Health & Social Psychology (2-year full-time, RCI-recognised); failing such candidates, MA/MSc in Psychology and related subjects (regular course). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Regular course is mandatory for Clinical Psychologist. Applications from external sources will be rejected.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Correspondence courses are not accepted for Clinical Psychologist / Psychologist qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection on the basis of merit cum roster and rolling process. Suitable candidates considered as per roster cum merit under reservation. Merit cum roster and rolling process. Candidates considered as per roster cum merit under reservation.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for a period of one year. Funded by Karnataka Mining Environment Restoration Corporation (KMRC) grant.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Taluk Mental Health Programme, Challakere.
